name: Rosewood
bestFor: Learning short routes and basic base planning
challenge: Compact town planning with fewer major escape complications than larger urban areas.

name: Riverside
bestFor: Slower route expansion and safer recovery loops
challenge: Calmer town planning with less immediate pressure but fewer high-value rewards than harder areas.

name: Muldraugh
bestFor: Practicing staged routes and longer road planning
challenge: Longer town movement where overextension becomes a bigger problem than in compact beginner areas.

name: West Point
bestFor: Experienced route discipline and higher-pressure looting
challenge: Valuable routes with less room for mistakes, especially when players stay exposed too long.

name: Louisville
bestFor: Veteran city survival and advanced route control
challenge: Dense city survival with higher pressure, longer routes and more demanding exit planning.
